name: w60_bc_a2
_comment: Beam cap A2 (kits/w60_beamcap.mjs, pilot pilots/w60_bc_a.json): as w60_bc_a, but the red BC Probe (wëap 337, Reload 600) is fired by Ctrl TAPS, one a second from 4 s after the spray stops until 100 s (a held Ctrl fired nothing in w60_bc_a): with the table full of spokes, does the probe fire at the first tap after the first spoke expires (a refused shot keeps the weapon ready) or only 20 s after a refused tap (a refusal costs the reload)?
